name: Mubadala Capital
seen_with: Apollo; Goldman Sachs (advisor); Jefferies (advisor); Morgan Stanley (advisor)
rationale: Mubadala's ~$60B+ alternative-asset-management arm (distinct GP from the sovereign parent Mubadala/MGX) just opened itself to outside minority capital -- Apollo plus ~$5B aggregate from unnamed strategic investors, announced 2026-10-26, expected close Q4 2026.
